_doc: Performance budgets (harness/bin/perfbudget.mjs). SIGNED with the style (P0-015, 2026-11-11, decisions.md 'Style bible and signed budgets'). The target is Anmol's (decisions.md 'Performance target'): 'The game should be able to run on Mac M2 smoothly. No struggles.' Minimum machine is the M2 Pro, 60 fps steady at play speed, rendered near 1080p and upscaled. frameMs is the p95 frame time (the larger of CPU and GPU) of the LOOK scenes: graphics may use about 10 to 11 ms so 5 to 6 ms of the 16.6 ms frame stay free for gameplay, AI, physics and streaming. warn 10.0 is the low end of that band, fail 12.0 still leaves 4.6 ms. Measured stylised_b on the stand-ins after P0-037 (Vulkan, M2 Pro, vsync off, sim held, calm machine, 4 lights x 9 views): GPU p95 6.5 to 9.3 ms (worst view per light 7.75 to 9.29, typical 6.6 to 8.0), CPU p95 under 1 ms, 96 to 315 draw calls, 0.77 to 3.2 M triangles with shadow passes, load 1.06 to 1.33 s. Draw calls, triangles and memory keep room for the real content that the stand-ins lack (kit textures, crowds, traffic, vehicles, landmarks): about 2x the worst measured view at warn and 3x at fail; the per-system and streamed-city numbers come from the architecture sign-off (TECH.md 'Performance budgets'). Night GPU time reads 3 to 5 ms higher when other GPU work runs on the machine (a browser, another game): judge budgets on a calm machine (check `ps -r`), rerun a fail once before it counts. The Metal driver reports no GPU time: use HARNESS_GODOT_ARGS='--rendering-driver vulkan --disable-vsync' for GPU numbers. Every light (dawn, afternoon, golden, night) shares these numbers.

signed.by: Anmol (style sign-off 'Yes, I sign off on stylised B as the Kalesh style.' and the performance target); numbers set by the planner from the target and the P0-037 measurements

target: Apple M2 Pro MacBook Pro (12 CPU cores, 19 core GPU, 16 GB) is the minimum machine: 60 fps steady at play speed, 1920x1080 render scale 1.0 (or about 1080p upscaled to the display), Godot 4.7.2.stable standard build, Forward+ renderer (Vulkan through MoltenVK for GPU times, Metal for play), one game window, calm machine (load per core under 0.6)
